messages:
Maya: Quick design pass for the vector preview + export modal. Sharing mock and a few copy variations. Want accessibility + copy + edge cases before sprint.
Maya: mock link: https://figma.com/xyz
Maya: Major things: export size limit language, selection UX, keyboard order, export filename default
Sam T: looks great. on export size language — prefer 'Export up to 10k vectors per file' vs 'limited to 10k' - less alarming
Sam T: Also can we show estimated file size next to number? e.g. 10k ~ 12MB
Jordan (PM): We need header copy to mention that embedding dims may vary across models. suggested: 'Exports reflect the model and quantization used for generation.'
Lee - Eng: Implementation notes: server already streams CSV, but inline compression (.gz) needs backend flag. Keyboard nav is doable, focus trap required for modal. We should avoid blocking main thread for large exports; queue with progress UI is necessary.
Ash - Accessibility: A few nits: export button needs aria-label 'Export selected vectors', batch checkbox should have aria-describedby linking to export limits. color contrast for inline pill is 3.2:1 currently -> should be >=4.5:1 for text on bg.
Maya: good catches Ash. Propose three copy variants for header — A/B test maybe in canary:
Maya: 1) 'Download vectors for offline analysis — includes id + embedding values.'
Maya: 2) 'Export vector rows (id + embeddings) — format: CSV or JSONL.'
Maya: 3) 'Download embeddings. File contains vector values and source id.'
Sam T: prefer 2, explicit formats helps
Jordan (PM): also include link to docs in modal 'Learn more about export formats' -> use small link text
Lee - Eng: suggest adding tooltip on 'JSONL' with example line: `{"id": "row-1", "embedding": [0.12, -0.3...]}`
Ash - Accessibility: tooltips must be accessible (focusable, role='tooltip', dismissable with ESC)
Maya: Another flow question — if user chooses 'include source text' should we truncate long text columns? propose: collapse long text with 'Show full' link in preview column, but export full text by default unless user toggles 'truncate in export'
Sam T: truncation in export sounds risky for users. Default to full export, but show warning if row > 1MB
Jordan (PM): agree full export default, but we can gate with size warning and suggest splitting export into chunks.
Lee - Eng: backend: streaming export already handles chunking; front-end can enforce per-file limit and create multiple files then zip. Feasible.
Maya: Accessibility nit: keyboard order in vector preview table — filter > search > table > export CTA. @ash_accessibility can we do a quick audit?
Ash - Accessibility: yep I can do audit tomorrow. I'll add checklist: focus order, skip links, aria-live region for export progress, screen reader text for 'rows selected: X'
Sam T: small copy tweak for the relevance table: 'Score' -> 'Relevance score (higher is better)'
Maya: Nice. Also add column description in column header hover.
Jordan (PM): Can we surface top-k chosen for rerank in export? e.g., include 'rerank_rank' column if rerank applied
Lee - Eng: that's a metadata toggle — easy to add if PM wants.
Maya: Final asks before I update figma: - pick header copy (2 preferred) - add aria-describedby IDs - show estimated file size - show per-file row limit and automatic zipping - include docs link
Jordan (PM): I'll confirm product priorities; sounds good for next sprint.
Maya: thanks everyone. I'll push updated figma and post another thread with final copy. :rocket:
deploy-bot: design snapshot uploaded: https://redwood.design/snapshots/1767000000
Ash - Accessibility: assigned follow-up audit to me
Lee - Eng: noted backend ticket required: INF-8132
Sam T: LGTM :thumbsup:
